description: Executable navigation contract layered over analysis/ui-state-map.yml. Edges are deliberately conservative: 'verified' means reproduced locally; 'documented' means primary-manual behavior; 'historical' means recovered automation evidence; 'hypothesis' is a probe target.

status_meanings.verified: Locally reproduced in a deterministic fixture/runtime.
status_meanings.documented: Stated by primary manual but not yet locally promoted.
status_meanings.historical: Recovered from historical automation/source and not yet locally promoted.
status_meanings.hypothesis: Cheap candidate transition awaiting runtime evidence.

multiplayer_behavioral_verification.integration_note: PR #31 already provides the shared P1/P2 transport across native, snesref, and Mesen. This dependency now tracks only behavioral proof: P2-only causality, P1->P2 rider-selection handoff, stable multiplayer checkpoints, and deeper VS navigation.
multiplayer_behavioral_verification.note: 2P entry/back and VS_SELECT plus the visual P1->P2 VS handoff are locally reproduced. Remaining acceptance work is P2-only causality/confirmation, 2P handoff through TOUR_SELECT, deeper VS challenger/track checkpoints, and multiplayer gameplay/split-screen evidence. 2026-10-03: VS_CHALLENGER (0x3F) and VS_CHALLENGE_TRACK (0x5A) are now reproduced on snesref (dual-controller patch) after a decided VS race (tools/probe_vs_challenger.py, analysis/generated/vs-challenger-probe.json); native-recomp and Mesen confirmation of that route remain.
